title: Symmetry of Gaussian quadrant probabilities
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $(X,Y)$ have the centered bivariate Gaussian law with unit variances and correlation $\rho$. For every $t\in\mathbb R$, the probability that $X>-t$ and $Y>-t$ equals the probability that $X\le t$ and $Y\le t$.
